newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down as investors booked profit on a wide range of scrips, ending a brief two-session rally, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index ended 50.52 points or 1.49 percent at 3,317.57 on a turnover of 178.6 million taka. Of 119 issues traded 81 lost and 38 gained.

"The market is stabilising. Ups and downs are normal. Prolonged rally seen in recent months was abnormal. The investors appear to have learnt a lot out of it," said broker Khurshid Alam. Monno Fabrics shed 13.66 taka to 259.60 and Square Pharma gained 110.28 to 2,368.34. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
